plugin.name: Proxmox VE
plugin.description: Manage Proxmox VE from Termix: virtual machines, containers, storage, network, backups, firewall, access and the cluster.

view.title: View Proxmox
view.description: See nodes, guests, storage, charts and tasks on Proxmox hosts you can connect to.

operate.title: Operate Proxmox guests
operate.description: Start, stop, shut down, reboot, suspend and resume VMs and containers. Needs edit access to the host.

configure.title: Configure Proxmox
configure.description: Create, clone, migrate, convert and delete VMs and containers. Needs edit access to the host.

administer.title: Administer Proxmox
administer.description: Manage users, groups, roles, pools, 2FA, tokens, realms and the cluster. Needs edit access to the host.

enable.label: Proxmox node
enable.description: Mark this host as a Proxmox VE node. It then shows in the Proxmox tool under Tools.

transport.label: Connect through
transport.description: Automatic uses the API over an SSH tunnel once a token is saved, and pvesh over SSH until then.

tokenId.label: API token ID
tokenId.description: Made in Proxmox under Datacenter, Permissions, API Tokens. Looks like user@realm!name.

tokenSecret.label: API token secret
tokenSecret.description: Shown once when the token is made. Stored encrypted.

apiHost.label: API address
apiHost.description: API directly only. Leave empty to use this host's address.

caCert.label: CA certificate
caCert.description: API directly only. The node's CA in PEM, from /etc/pve/pve-root-ca.pem. Leave empty if the API has a publicly trusted certificate.

app.pickResource: Pick a node, guest or storage on the left
app.noHostsHint: Open a host's settings, turn on Proxmox node under SSH, and pick how to connect. The node then shows here.

errors.tlsUntrusted: Termix does not trust the node's certificate. In the host's Proxmox settings, paste the node's CA from /etc/pve/pve-root-ca.pem into CA certificate, or pick API over SSH tunnel.
errors.tlsHostname: The node's certificate is for another name. Set API address to a name or address the certificate lists.
errors.tlsExpired: The node's certificate has expired or is not valid yet. Renew it in Proxmox under the node, System, Certificates.
errors.notEnabled: This host is not marked as a Proxmox node. Turn on Proxmox node in the host's settings.
errors.hostAccess: You need edit access to this host to change it.

confirm.description: This cuts the power like pulling the plug. Work that is not saved in the guest is lost.

clone.title: Clone {{name}}
clone.label: Clone {{source}} to {{id}}
clone.fullHint: Copies every disk, so the clone does not depend on the original.
clone.linkedHint: Off makes a linked clone that shares the template's disks and is made in seconds.

migrate.title: Migrate {{name}}
migrate.label: Migrate {{name}} to {{target}}
migrate.noOtherNodes: There is no other online node in this cluster to move it to.
migrate.onlineHint: The VM is running and moves live, without stopping.
migrate.restartHint: The container is running. It stops, moves and starts again on the target.

template.description: A template can't be started, only cloned. This can't be undone.
template.label: Convert {{name}} to a template

delete.title: Delete {{name}}
delete.label: Delete {{name}}
delete.warning: This deletes guest {{vmid}} and its disks. It can't be undone.
delete.stopFirst: Stop the guest before deleting it.
delete.purge: Remove from backup jobs, replication and HA
delete.purgeHint: Leaves no jobs pointing at a guest that is gone.
delete.unreferencedHint: Disks on enabled storages with this ID that the config does not list.

create.noTemplates: No container templates on this node. Download one in Proxmox under a storage, CT Templates.
create.unprivilegedHint: Safer: root in the container is not root on the node.
create.loginHint: Set a root password, SSH keys, or both.

problem.vmid: Pick an ID of 100 or more.
problem.hostname: Enter a hostname: letters, digits and dashes.
problem.name: Enter a name: letters, digits and dashes.
problem.memory: Enter at least 16 MiB of memory.
problem.swap: Enter swap in MiB, 0 for none.
problem.network: Pick a bridge and, for a static address, enter it like 192.168.0.60/24.
problem.login: Set a root password or SSH keys so you can log in.
problem.password: The password needs at least 5 characters.
